title: Dudley Community Resident Dean Assistant Dean of Harvard College Resident Dean for Visiting Undergraduate Students
bio: I am the Resident Dean for all undergraduates in Dudley Community, including students living in the Dudley Coop, off-campus students affiliated with Dudley, and all Visiting Undergraduate Students. In my spare time, I like listening to hiphop, walking in the woods, reading, and trying new things. I came to Harvard in 2006 to advise concentrators in Psychology, and joined Dudley in 2017.
